text_zh:
分级: Apollyon
发现地点: 第XII层 引擎核心 守卷人议会空席

描述: 一卷失封羊皮纸，载录初铭秘仪之全文。接触者报告所有已习铭文组自发剥落，随后表现出异常的基石流纯化现象。██名键徒在失去全部铭文组后，其收容基准达成率反而上升███%。

备注: 条例§12.7要求将此物移交深层收容，但相关表单F-███已连续三个月未能完成流转。处理权限仍在审批中。

附录: 末席守卷人签章依然可见，但墨迹正在缓慢消退。
text_en:
Object Class: Apollyon
Recovery Site: Layer XII, Engine Core, Council Empty Seats

Description: Unsealed parchment scroll containing complete text of First Inscription rites. Subjects report spontaneous detachment of all acquired inscriptions upon contact, followed by anomalous purification of Foundation Humour flow. ██ keepers achieved ███% higher containment threshold completion rates after losing all inscription arrays.

Note: Regulation §12.7 mandates transfer to deep containment, but Form F-███ has failed processing for three consecutive months. Handling clearance remains pending.

Addendum: Final Signatory's seal still visible, though ink continues to fade slowly.
